identity.name: Abhishek P R
identity.tagline: Building cloud infrastructure and automated deployment pipelines with AWS, Docker, and Terraform.

about: I am a Computer Science Engineering graduate and Junior DevOps Engineer passionate about building reliable cloud infrastructure and automated delivery pipelines. My technical expertise spans AWS cloud services, Infrastructure as Code with Terraform, Docker containerization, and CI/CD workflows using GitHub Actions. Through hands-on personal projects, I have built modular AWS architectures with S3 remote state locking, configured Nginx reverse proxies for containerized microservices, and automated continuous deployments to EC2 over SSH. I am CCNA-trained and currently preparing for the AWS Solutions Architect Associate exam. I am seeking a long-term engineering role where I can optimize infrastructure, enforce DevSecOps standards, and scale systems reliably.

projects.title: Terraform AWS Production Lab
projects.description: Modular AWS infrastructure provisioned with Terraform, featuring remote state locking, drift detection, and resource imports. Architected a multi-environment setup (VPC, public subnet, IGW, route table, security group, EC2 web server) using reusable Terraform modules with centralized S3 remote state.
features: Modular HCL architecture across dev, staging, and prod
S3 bucket import with prevent_destroy lifecycle rules
projects.takeaway: Remote state locking prevents a class of bugs that are almost impossible to debug in production.

projects.title: Calculator CI/CD with SonarCloud
projects.description: Python Flask calculator API with Pytest unit testing, SonarCloud quality gates, Docker build, and automated EC2 deployment over SSH. Built a full GitHub Actions pipeline that automates the entire delivery lifecycle from code push to production.
features: Pytest suite triggered on every push
SonarCloud DevSecOps static analysis + quality gate
Docker image build and push to Docker Hub
Automated continuous deployment to AWS EC2
projects.takeaway: Quality gates in CI catch issues before code review.

projects.title: Docker Multi-App
projects.description: Multi-container microservices architecture featuring a Python Flask backend and Nginx reverse proxy connected across a custom Docker bridge network. Automated build, networking, and health validation with a Bash script.
features: Dual Dockerfiles for clean separation of concerns
Custom Docker bridge network for DNS service discovery
Nginx reverse proxy forwarding 8085 to backend 5000
run.sh automation for build and verification
projects.takeaway: Custom bridge networks give DNS-based discovery for free - no hardcoded IPs.
